decision: An agent step is a PROPOSAL, not a decision (hybrid 'agent proposes, human confirms'). Every governed step resolves into exactly one of three outcomes: proceed (confidence >= threshold AND action within grants -> agent fills/routes, human sees result + reasoning-trace), defer-to-human (confidence < threshold OR ambiguity OR borderline attribute -> agent does NOT decide; materializes an ORDINARY inbox task (E7) 'needs review' with the precise doubt reason; reasoning-trace explains the doubt), fail-closed (action outside grants / tool error / egress block -> step stops, audit event written, role escalation; NEVER silently skip). LOAD-BEARING INVARIANT (default-to-human): proceed is reachable ONLY when every affirming condition holds; any denial, any ambiguity, any tool error, and any unrecognised/missing signal resolve to NOT-proceed (defer for soft uncertainty, fail-closed for structural denial). Trust = predictable stop, not infallibility. Confidence (founder decision B.5, 2026-06-14) = BOTH signals at once, disjunction on the defer side: deterministic threshold from DMN/agent_card.autonomy_threshold (auditable framework) AND model self-confidence (sensitivity signal); defer fires if EITHER the threshold is breached OR the model reports low confidence. Implementation is 'nothing new beyond the envelope': defer -> ordinary inbox task (reuse claim/SLA/notifications), fail-closed -> existing PDP-deny (T-0021) + audit-floor (T-0016); the two events agent.deferred / agent.blocked are open-vocab `type` strings on the existing audit_event (audit_event.type is text NOT NULL with NO CHECK, migrations/006), NO new table/column. Design-only: no migration, no ci/checks edit, no production code; freezes the model, invariants, event contracts and fitness functions the B-2 impl (T-0221) must satisfy.

rejected_alternatives.why_not: actor_event verb-set is CLOSED and vocab-pinned (T-0019 {request,prepare,submit,approve,release}); these are governance-audit (what went wrong), not SoD facts. Open-vocab audit_event.type is the correct home; adding them to actor_event reddens actor_event_vocab_pinned with no SoD benefit.
Violates 'nothing new beyond the envelope' (B.3); audit_event (open-vocab) + inbox (E7) cover all day-1. A new table triggers a founder-gate and drift, with no benefit.

rejected_alternatives.option: proceed as the default branch of the classifier
rejected_alternatives.why_not: Directly breaks INV-DEFAULT; signal incompleteness would yield 'agent guessed'. proceed must be the remainder when ALL gates are green, never the fallback branch.

rejected_alternatives.option: Only the deterministic threshold OR only model self-confidence
rejected_alternatives.why_not: Contradicts founder decision B.5 ('BOTH at once'): a threshold alone misses ambiguity, a model alone is not auditable. Both, disjoined on the defer side, are required.

rejected_alternatives.option: Silently continue with a default value on tool error
rejected_alternatives.why_not: Explicitly forbidden by B.2 ('NEVER silently skip'); kills the trust-red-line of the first customer.
Duplicates existing actor_event/lifecycle-audit producers; day-1 only deviations (deferred/blocked) are materialized in audit.
The column is dormant per T-0020 ('E5.7 enforces, Stage-2'); enforcement is Stage-2/T-0123. T-0220 is the model, not the autonomy runtime.

fields.name: proceed
fields.type: agent fills/routes; human sees result + reasoning-trace; emits NO new audit type (reuses actor_event/lifecycle-audit)

fields.name: defer-to-human
fields.type: materializes an ordinary inbox task (E7) with doubt_reason; emits agent.deferred

fields.name: fail-closed
fields.type: step stops; role escalation; emits agent.blocked; NEVER silent

fields.name: deterministicThreshold
fields.type: auditable framework: DMN rule (sum/category) + agent_card.autonomy_threshold numeric(5,4) [0,1] (migrations/032_agent_card.sql, dormant day-1)

fields.name: modelConfidence
fields.type: model self-assessment signal; competence layer T-0123 (instruction 'when in doubt, ask' + per-agent field, NOT BUILT)

fields.name: combination
fields.type: defer if (thresholdBreached OR modelConfidence < threshold OR ambiguous); proceed requires BOTH green

fields.name: type
fields.type: string literal 'agent.deferred' (audit_event.type text NOT NULL, NO CHECK, open-vocab)

fields.name: payload
fields.type: jsonb hash-covered (preimage field #11): { doubtReason, signal: 'threshold'|'model'|'ambiguity', inboxTaskId, reasoningTraceRef }

fields.name: actor/subject/via
fields.type: actor=agent employee.id (kind='agent'); subject=case object; via=step channel

fields.name: payload
fields.type: jsonb: { cause: 'pdp_deny'|'tool_error'|'egress_block', denyReason?, toolRef?, escalatedToRole, reasoningTraceRef }; denyReason for pdp_deny == resolveFor reason

contracts: classifyOutcome(signals) -> 'proceed'|'defer-to-human'|'fail-closed': TOTAL pure function. Priority: fail-closed (structuralDenial OR toolError OR egressBlocked) > defer (thresholdFailed OR modelConfidence<threshold OR ambiguous OR any-unrecognised-signal) > proceed (remainder, ONLY when none above). proceed is NEVER the default branch (INV-DEFAULT).
fail-closed for pdp_deny is an audit PROJECTION of an already-taken PDP-deny (resolveFor -> { denied:true, reason }), NOT a second authorization path; authority stays single (T-0021).
defer producer materializes an ORDINARY inbox task (same HTTP/state contract as src/http/inbox.ts: role-addressed, sla, claimable from pool), filling doubt_reason; no new task type/table.

agent.deferred / agent.blocked are emitted via the existing appendAuditEvent (src/db/audit-writer.ts) as open-vocab `type` strings; encoder modeled on lifecycle-audit.ts / audit-grant-encoder.ts. Reasoning-trace ref lives in payload (T-0139 channel).

Threshold is READ from agent_card.autonomy_threshold (migrations/032) OR the process DMN rule via a seam; never hardcoded in the outcome model. T-0123 supplies the instruction/per-agent threshold (dependency, paused, not a day-1 precondition).

fitness_functions.rule: classifyOutcome is total, returns exactly one of three outcomes
fitness_functions.ci_check: Static-now: unit-golden over a signal table; every input maps to exactly one outcome, no undefined.
Static-now: property/golden — for any input where threshold/model/ambiguity are not both green (incl. missing signal), outcome != proceed.

fitness_functions.rule: proceed reachable ONLY with PDP-allow AND both confidence gates
fitness_functions.ci_check: Static-now golden: PDP-deny OR threshold-fail OR low-model-conf => outcome != proceed.
Static-now: each fail-closed input => exactly one audit_event type='agent.blocked' with cause in {pdp_deny,tool_error,egress_block}.

fitness_functions.ci_check: Static-now (encoder) + live-DB (inbox write): defer input => inbox task with non-empty doubt_reason AND agent.deferred whose inboxTaskId == that task id.

fitness_functions.ci_check: Static-now lint: producer emits same shape as src/http/inbox.ts (role/sla/claim); no new task table.
Static-now golden: value taken from resolveFor reason, not a free string.
Static-now grep: migrations/ has no new type-CHECK; events flow through the `type` string (audit-writer.ts).

fitness_functions.rule: proceed emits no new audit type
fitness_functions.ci_check: Static-now lint: no type='agent.proceeded' in the encoder.

fitness_functions.ci_check: Static-now lint: agent.deferred/agent.blocked not among ACTOR_EVENT_VERBS; actor_event_vocab_pinned green.

fitness_functions.rule: reasoning-trace accompanies both defer and block
fitness_functions.ci_check: Static-now golden: payload of both events carries reasoningTraceRef (T-0139 channel).

fitness_functions.rule: threshold read from agent_card.autonomy_threshold/DMN, not hardcoded
fitness_functions.ci_check: Static-now lint: no literal threshold in the outcome-model code; source is the seam.

fitness_functions.ci_check: Static-now golden: input with PDP-deny AND low-confidence => fail-closed, not defer.

traceability.covered_by: ADR §5.2/§5.4 open-vocab type, no new column (T-0016)

runtime_target: Existing choros dev stack (single-Postgres substrate + node:http) on the founder home server (/srv/choros, deploy founder-gated). NO new migration, table, external resource, or CI shell check (mirrors T-0139). No founder gate (no new infra/server/DB provisioning). Not built here (seams for T-0221): the producer emitting agent.deferred/agent.blocked via appendAuditEvent (encoder modeled on lifecycle-audit.ts/audit-grant-encoder.ts); the producer placing the defer task into the inbox; reading the threshold from agent_card.autonomy_threshold/DMN. Dependency: T-0123 (competence layer — instruction/per-agent threshold) is paused, not a day-1 precondition.
